lines: A moment that seems like it could change me, even the world
is always right beside me...
I face the irritation I can't hide, and myself standing frozen
Wavering, agonizing
Regretting — then all I have to do is decide
One word you gave me, and my hesitation vanished
Light poured into my room, once so empty
The sky I looked up at grows clear and blue
I've decided to open the window I shut
A moment that seems like it could change me, even the world
is always right beside me...
Searching for the answer that should exist in a life that never feels full
Alone in the morning sun — when I turn toward a gentle voice
in the dazzling light, you suddenly smile
The window I shut is about to open
An existence that seems like it could change me, even the world
is right before my eyes...
The sky I looked up at grows clear and blue
I've decided to open the window I shut
A moment that seems like it could change me, even the world
I feel it, here and now...
Reaching both hands toward the light...
The color of the sky sweeping through my heart, the fragrant breeze
